values.note: 82 campsites, 31 full hookup and 19 electric-only per the park page; 'Campers with units over 25 feet in length may contact the park to discuss suitable sites.'

sites.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/pipestem-state-park/activities/camping-at-pipestem-state-park/ ('features 82 campsites open year-round, 31 of which are equipped with full hookups. Nineteen sites are electric only.'; 'Small pop-up tents, large RVs and everything in between are welcome. Campers with units over 25 feet in length may contact the park to discuss suitable sites.') + booking site unit tags (Pull Thru Site on 20 units), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Heated bathhouses, coin laundry, campground store, playground.

Reserve online (WV State Parks booking site), by phone or at the campground office. Weekend (Friday and Saturday) reservations need both nights; one night Sunday-Thursday. The booking site does sell a one-night Friday close in (Fri 2026-10-30, nine days out: 40 sites) but not months ahead (Fri 2027-06-18: none).

booking.source: https://wvstateparks.com/parks/pipestem-state-park/activities/camping-at-pipestem-state-park/ ('Campsites may be reserved anytime online, by phone, or at the campground office.'; 'Reservations may be made for no less than two consecutive nights on weekends (Friday and Saturday) or one-night Sunday through Thursday.'; 'There is a 14-night maximum stay.') + booking site supplier 11067676 (one night Fri 2027-06-18: 0 units; Fri-Sat 2027-06-18/20: 62; one night Fri 2026-10-30: 40), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed fees $39.99-54.99 (booking site, four seasons), year-round season, inherited booking (2-night weekend minimum, 14-night max) for Pipestem. Added hookups 50A/water/sewer, 82 sites with pull-throughs, laundry and store. Not stated: booking window, max rig (only 'over 25 feet, contact the park').
